last monday me and my colleague was discussing about the new grammar checker that we have been developing since two years. The feature look quite promising, but there is still alot of problems that needs to be fixed before we can release it to the users. We didnt had enough time to properly test everything, because the last few weeks has been extremely busy and everyone have other tasks to finish.
The first issue we noticed were related to spelling. For example, the application sometimes accept words such as "recieve", "seperate", "definately", "occured", "immediatly", "enviroment", "wierd", "succesful" and "untill" without showing any warning. This is particulary annoying because those mistakes are very common and a good spell checker should be able to detect them easilly. It also dont always notice duplicated words, for example when somebody writes "the the application crashed" or "we need to to restart it".
Another problems is sentence capitalization. sometimes the first word after a full stop remain lowercase. the same happens with days and months, for example monday, january and september. Proper names can also causes problems, specially when users writes things like "i work at microsoft" or "we visited portugal in august". The pronoun i should obviously always be uppercase, however right now the checker doesnt consistently correct it.
There is also several problems with subject verb agreement. A user sometimes write sentences such as "the feature work correctly", "the results looks good", "these option is disabled" or "each of the tests have passed". Neither of those sentence are correct, but some of them isn't detected. The system also struggle with constructions like "there is many errors", "there was several problems" and "there's two possible solutions".
Verb tense detection still need improvements too. Yesterday we test the application and find three serious bugs. Before that, we have tested an older build and everything worked much better. By the time the developer arrived, we already wait for almost two hours. If we would have tested this earlier, we could found the problem sooner. Tomorrow we tested another version if the build will be ready.
Articles are another area where the software make many mistakes. User can open editor, paste text into document and click button to start review. Application should then show list of detected issues. In some situations it suggest "a information", "an user" or "a apple", while in other places it completely forget an article. For example, "I bought new computer yesterday" should probably be "I bought a new computer yesterday".
Plural and uncountable nouns is difficult as well. We received many useful feedbacks from our users and several important informations from the testing team. One tester gave us three advices about the user interface and asked us to buy new equipments for the laboratory. We also need to review all the datas collected during previous tests and decide which criterias should be used.
Prepositions often causes subtle issues. She has been working here since three years, while I have worked here from 2021. We discussed about the problem during the meeting and agreed to investigate on it later. He is responsible of testing the Windows version, and I am interested on checking the Linux build. We arrived to the office at 9:00 and waited the manager for nearly 30 minutes.
Comparatives and superlatives should be tested carefully too. The new version is more faster than the previous one, but it is also much more simpler to use. This algorithm is the most easiest solution we tried so far. My laptop is more powerful then yours, although your computer performs good in some benchmarks. Of the two implementations, the second one is the best because it uses lesser memory.
Pronouns can be tricky. Me and him reviewed the pull request yesterday. The manager asked Sarah and I to prepare a report, then he gave the task to myself. Every developer should update their own documentation when he finish a feature. Between you and I, this solution doesnt seem very reliable. The company changed it's policy, but its unclear whether the change will affect us.
Negations should also be checked. We dont need no additional tests because nobody didnt report any new issues. I cant hardly understand why the build never doesn't finish. The developer said that he didn't do nothing wrong, but the logs showed several errors. We decided to not change nothing untill somebody complains.
Punctuation is probably one of the hardest areas however the checker should still catch obvious problems. The application works well however, it sometimes crashes after startup. We tested Chrome Firefox Edge and Safari but only Chrome worked correctly. My colleague said "this should work", but I wasnt convinced. If the build succeeds we will deploy it otherwise we will rollback the changes. The test finished successfully, unfortunately nobody saved the results.
Spacing and formatting should be tested aswell. For example, users may type 10kg, 25km, 100ms, 5GB or 20%CPU usage. They might also accidentally write spaces before punctuation ,like this , or forget spaces after commas,like this. Sometimes they use double  spaces between words or leave a space before a period .Parentheses can be wrong too( especially when spaces are missing ).
Numbers and dates creates additional edge cases. On 5th of september 2026 we performed 3 different test's using 2 machine's. The first machine had 16 gb of ram and the second had 32GB. Test number one took 1,5 seconds, while another took 0.75 sec. We measured a 20 percent improvement, but the CPU utilisation increased by 5 percents. The experiment was repeated on september 21th and october 3st.
Word choice is another important category. The new configuration had a big affect on performance, but it did not effect stability. We should insure that every setting is saved correctly. The new interface is very intuitive, accept for the advanced settings page. Their going to update the documentation later, but I don't know weather they will finish it today. The developer who's laptop crashed said that the problem was caused by a lose cable.
Some sentences are grammatical but still sounds unnatural. Please revert back the changes when you are finished. We need to collaborate together in order to improve the final outcome. The reason is because the server was overloaded. At this point in time, we are currently testing the newest version. Each and every developer should personally review their own individual changes. In my personal opinion, I think the interface is too complicated.
Conditional sentences also causes trouble. If I will find another bug, I will report it. If I would know about the issue yesterday, I would fix it. If the server wouldn't have crashed, the test would finish successfully. Unless you don't restart the application, the changes wont be applied. I wish the program would worked more reliably.
Questions and indirect questions are another useful test. Do you know where is the configuration file? Can you tell me why did the process crash? I wonder what does this option do. The manager asked did we finished the test. Nobody knows when will the new version be released.
There are also mistakes involving infinitives and gerunds. I enjoy to work on difficult technical problems, but I avoid to work late at night. The application allows users editing their text and helps them to finding mistakes. We decided testing the feature again tomorrow and suggested to add more unit tests. She made me to restart the service and let me to check the logs.
Finally the checker should deal with sentences which contains several mistakes at once. yesterday me and john was working on a feature which don't works properly, and we was trying to understand why does it crashes every few minute. after nearly two hour we finally finded the problem; there was too much threads running at same time and each of them were consuming more memory then they should of. We fixed the bug, ran the tests again and everything seem to work good, but nobody have checked if the solution actually solve the original issue yet.
